# KaTeX 0.16.11 (vendored)

Math typesetting for the Formula tool (`src/pdf/formula.ts`), bundled so it
works offline and without an npm install.

- `katex.mjs`, `katex.min.css`, `fonts/*.woff2` come unchanged from the
  official release archive
  https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/download/v0.16.11/katex.tar.gz
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`).

To update: download a newer release archive and replace these files.
